legend.missing: the field the gate needs was blank or unresolved, so the rule did not run
legend.judged: a rule or score was evaluated and failed

panel.standalone_tip: Standalone counts ignore the other gates, so they overlap.
panel.nothing: Nothing removed at this gate for this selection.
panel.hint: Each text is dropped at the first gate it fails.
head.none: No policy texts in this combination
head.some_html_one: {final} of {total} policy texts ({pct}) survives every gate
notes.n1_html: Status recorded as enacted: status reads “enacted”; federal legislation needs a public-law id. {id_verified} of {surv} records are confirmed by id.
notes.n2_html: Family cluster filter: excludes state texts in model-labelled families with enacted records under at least 3 distinct state/DC jurisdiction labels within ±1 year; federal texts, undated texts and texts with generic family labels pass.
notes.n3_html: Outside the COVID window: dates from 2020-01-01 to 2021-12-31 are excluded; undated texts pass. Other calendar flags are recorded.
notes.n4_html: Public data linkable: the datasets field matches a curated registry by name; mixed public and restricted data passes. Of the {final} on the shortlist, {zero} match no public source.
notes.n5_html: Lowest sub-score: the lowest of four model-generated sub-scores must reach 3; data feasibility reaches 3 for {p3} of {n} policy texts entering.
foot_html: Generated {date}. Source: policy database. Duplicate text IDs removed (first row kept).
err.load: Could not render the funnel data.
Every unique policy_id in the 483k polic: Unique text IDs in the policy database; first row kept. A text is a bill version, law, rule, notice, committee report, hearing or chapter.
G1: status is 'enacted' and, for federal: Status recorded as enacted; federal legislation needs a public-law ID.
wave_flag = 0: fewer than 3 distinct sta: Family cluster filter: excludes state texts in model-labelled families with enacted records under at least 3 distinct state/DC jurisdiction labels within ±1 year; federal texts, undated texts and texts with generic family labels pass.
No covid_window confound flag (policy da: Dates from 2020-01-01 to 2021-12-31 are excluded; undated texts pass. Other calendar flags are recorded.
G2: data_verdict is public_ok or mixed,: Dataset names match the curated public-microdata registry; mixed public and restricted data passes. Blank, unmatched and restricted-only data fails.
min_gate >= 3: the lowest of the four LL: Lowest of the four model sub-scores (significance, identification, treatment intensity, data feasibility) is at least 3.
Status is present (e.g. proposed) and is: Status is recorded as proposed or another non-enacted value.
Status field is blank or 'unknown': enac: Enactment status is blank or unknown.
No G1 record exists for this id, so enac: Enactment was not evaluated for this text.
Duplicate id: the G1 layer says enacted,: Duplicate ID: enactment and merged records disagree; unresolved.
Rule evaluated: >=3 states enacted in th: Rule evaluated: ≥3 distinct state/DC jurisdiction labels have enacted records in the model-labelled family within ±1 year.
Rule evaluated on a parsed date that lie: Rule evaluated on a parsed date that lies in 2020-2021.
No datasets named in the datasets field.
Datasets are named but none links to the: Datasets are named but none links to the curated registry, so accessibility is unresolved.
Datasets resolved, and all are restricte: Datasets resolved, and all are restricted-access.
At least one of the four sub-scores is a: At least one of the four sub-scores is absent or non-numeric; min-gate undefined.
All four sub-scores present; the weakest: All four sub-scores present; the weakest is below the threshold of 3.
